notes.title: Closure of “A Twisted Path to Renown”
notes.notes:
[p]It is with great appreciation and a heavy heart that we announce the removal of “A Twisted Path to Renown” from Steam. Starting next month the game will no longer be available.[/p][p]We are incredibly grateful to everyone who has played and supported “A Twisted Path to Renown”. Over time, your passion and dedication have built a vibrant community and memorable experiences for players around the world.[/p][p]This decision was not made lightly, and we understand it may come as a disappointment. After careful consideration of various factors, we are no longer able to continue offering “A Twisted Path to Renown” through Steam.[/p][p]We extend our deepest gratitude to each of you who has joined us on this adventure. Your stories and connections within the game will always hold a special place in our hearts.[/p][p]Thank you for being a part of the “A Twisted Path to Renown” community.[/p][p]
With gratitude,[/p][p]The “A Twisted Path to Renown” Team[/p]

notes.title: A Twisted Path To Renown 1.0 is released!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome to the Release of v1.0 of A Twisted Path To Renown![/b]
 
[b]Dear Players![/b]
Today marks a huge milestone – we’re proud to officially release Version 1.0 of the game! A Twisted Path To Renown now has all the core elements to ensure a successful and challenging start for every player. We’re incredibly excited to share this version with you all. And by the way, we’ve decided to keep your hard-earned progress intact – no server wipes! All your previous progression will be saved as we launch the release version, so you can continue your journey without starting over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/f6ed97aef7452b58d85fa5bb05e2981639a39cc3.png[/img] 
[b]So, what does the game look like now?[/b]

[b]Two Unique Maps – PvE and PvP Challenges[/b]
At its heart, A Twisted Path To Renown remains a tactical extraction shooter with two versatile maps:

[b]Arizona Forest:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/36da6e4cd4dd4405bad97fc02634c055b1a5866b.jpg[/img]

A vast, PvE-oriented map with long distances between POIs, offering strategic and immersive gameplay for explorers and scavengers.

[b]Tennessee Hills: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/1af6a7e9f4ff93dd6beddf48d2c6dd265368ffc1.jpg[/img]

A more compact, PvP-focused battlefield where every sound matters and danger lurks around every corner.

[b]The Homestead – A Business Growth Simulator[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/aaf5df6be7847f76253f7d3aba1c59b74fdbb779.jpg[/img]

In fact it’s a realistic and dynamic economic hub where every profit, loss, and success depends on your choices, actions, and investment. Whether you decide to dominate as a fighter or grow as a businessman, the Homestead works 24/7, even when you’re offline. Give it a try!

[b]Reputation System – Friends or Foes?[/b]
Now you decide – fight everyone or build alliances. The new Reputation System lets you forge relationships with factions, giving you safety, resources, and unique benefits. How you interact with the world will shape your journey and survival.

[b]Quests – Tied to Reputation[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/fd2c90dadb47edb8d0b93133407dc1bf407c58e8.jpg[/img]

Quests are your path to improving reputation and reaping rewards. Some quests stand alone, perfect for polishing your skills, while others may force you to choose sides, impacting your faction relationships. Be careful – your decisions matter!

[b]AI Improvements – A Living, Breathing World[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/59a7ed2d9b847817c58fbfaff7ddb3163733e555.png[/img]

From day one, we’ve worked to create an AI that feels alive, responsive, and realistic. With this release, we’ve reached our closest vision yet:
NPCs now have daily routines, realistic behaviors, and lifelike interactions.
Their survivability, reactions, and unique phrases breathe life into a world that feels like it exists on its own.

[b]A Journey Forward – This Is Just the Beginning[/b]
While v1.0 brings all the core aspects we’ve envisioned, there’s much more to come – new features, events, and ideas are already around the corner.

We couldn’t have done this without our greatest asset – you, our Community. Your time, effort, feedback, and passion have shaped this game, and together, we’ll take it even further.

[b]And last but not least - we're releasing the game with the 30% discount![/b]

The path to renown is yours to claim. See you in the raids!

~ Your ATPTR Team

notes.title: The Tennessee Hills map is here!

The long-awaited Tennessee map, new locations, new Bosses, new extractions and new rewards! 

Dear Players!

The wait is finally over! 
We’re happy to introduce Tennessee Hills, a brand-new map many of you have been waiting for.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/edbf71219defb0caf10cea3d74b1dae5ced644da.png[/img]

[b]What’s New?[/b]

This smaller, PVP-focused map offers a fresh experience while maintaining the open exploration feel of the Arizona Forest.

From the start, you’ll gain access to four new locations:
[b]
The Church[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/ebee8ffaa22b37bef797f3918bb2104989f607dc.jpg[/img]

[b]The Farm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/d692cef53c94884ba7ca2466c1912c4604cb03db.jpg[/img]

[b]The Old Prison[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/6ea9c8de569c2eb15fe0d900f3cbe62abd1c5384.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/0c6a161c934f313452f513a353d5f737874df585.jpg[/img]

You will need to develop new strategies as you face new Bosses, uncover new extraction points, and chase down new rewards. Tennessee Hills promises to bring exciting challenges and emotions!

As development continues, we’re committed to adding even more content and features to the Tennessee Hills map and other game areas, making it richer and more immersive over time. Your opinions and feedback are invaluable to us, so don’t hesitate to share your thoughts – we’re always listening!

This update also addresses critical performance and connection improvements, resolving recent issues like the 'endless matchmaking' and login problems.

A heartfelt thank you to everyone who contributed their time, effort, and feedback to make this update smoother and more engaging for our community.

Enjoy the adventure and happy exploring!
~ Your ATPTR Team

notes.title: The Major Update is today!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited Homestead is now available! Hire, produce, cooperate, and participate on your own Land! Earn Reputation with Factions, making numerous Quests or just being yourself! 



[b]Dear Players![/b]

We are happy to announce the massive upcoming Update for A Twisted Path To Renown. This update introduces game-changing features and expands the world in exciting new ways, bringing even more depth and variety to your journey.



[b]1. NPC daily activities[/b]
With this update, NPCs come to life like never before. Each NPC now has a daily routine – they work, eat, chat, and even relax by watching the sunset over the horizon. 
Now the land of Arizona feels even more alive, offering a dynamic world where every moment tells a story.

[b]2. Reputation System and Questlines[/b]
Your reputation now matters more than ever! Engage with the three distinct factions – each with its unique worldview and opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/fd2c90dadb47edb8d0b93133407dc1bf407c58e8.jpg[/img]

You can earn and build a reputation - as your actions will shape how each faction sees you, opening new quests, alliances, and consequences.
And we’re adding a deep Quest system - a diverse range of quests, from finding rare items to hunting treasures and killing dangerous enemies. Every decision you make influences your standing and unlocks unique rewards.

[b]3. Homestead Area[/b]
Yes, we’re adding Homestead, a dynamic space for growth, creativity, and strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/aaf5df6be7847f76253f7d3aba1c59b74fdbb779.jpg[/img]

Now you can construct houses, workshops, and industries, shaping your Homestead to fit your needs.
You will recruit and assign roles, bringing skilled recruits to your Homestead and giving them tasks like farming, crafting, or production.
You will use your resources to craft valuable items and trade them at the Auction for profit or power.
And even more: you can optimize and upgrade your buildings to make them more efficient, expand your production lines, and create a thriving economy.
[b]
4. Tennessee Hills Map – Coming Soon[/b]
You heard it right! The wait for a second map is almost over! 

The Tennessee Hills expansion is well underway and will be added shortly after the release of this Update. With new landscapes, challenges, and opportunities, it promises to make your PvP and PvE experience even more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/ebee8ffaa22b37bef797f3918bb2104989f607dc.jpg[/img]

This Update is a monumental step forward, offering endless possibilities for how you play and shape your journey in A Twisted Path To Renown. 
Stay tuned for more details and prepare to carve your path to renown like never before!

Happy playing!
~ Your ATPTR Team

notes.title: The BIG Update is here!
notes.notes:
While working on the next major update, we’ve managed to release a smaller update that brings the game closer to our original vision. This update includes a lot of new features, as well as bug and exploit fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/75ff1a48f98561c550baa100c9524ec34afccde8.png[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]NEW FEATURES:[/b]

- a new actions menu has been added to the gestures menu
- now if you're intoxicated, you can empty your stomach using the gestures and actions menu
- now you can “Tighten Buckles” on your Backpack, “Adjust Strap” on your Sidebag, and “Dust Off” the Clothes in the gestures and actions menu. This gives a temporary bonus to equipped item weight, making them feel lighter for your character, even though the actual weight remains the same
- now you can "Pray" in the gestures and actions menu, and feel blessed
- now if you're running barefoot you can get a splinter. It can be removed using the gestures and actions menu
- now your face sweats when you run, but you can easily wipe it with your hand using the gestures and actions menu

[b]GAMEPLAY:[/b]

- the climb/vault logic has been slightly improved  
- the gameplay in Fort Berry has been significantly changed
- the difficulty of S&O Iron Mine and all bosses have been slightly increased 
- added the new weapon HUD
- now, not only does the weight of clothing depend on durability, but so does the weight of all containers, including backpacks, sidebags, and storage boxes
- reworked pain and intoxication effects
- intoxication now affects weapon sway
- now some gestures have animations
- now gestures (Z-key) and quick item menu (~-key) can be used while moving
- the speed parameter for different boots has been adjusted
- the parameters "Intoxication" and "Pain Resistance" provided by certain items have been adjusted

[b]NETWORK:[/b]

- several improvements to the networking code have been made

[b]WEAPON ADJUSTMENTS:[/b]

- the weapon dynamic has been adjusted
- the hip fire is less accurate now
- the weapon spread has been redesigned, all weapons have a higher spread now
- the leather wrap stats on Model '62 and Model '95 have been fixed
- the mufflers now significantly reduce weapon range
- now the weapon's durability impacts not only spread but speed and range too

[b]AI:[/b]

- AI now stays in combat state longer once they enter a fight
- the weapons used by some AI have been changed

[b]FIXES:[/b]

- the occasional crash in Workshop/Repair has been fixed
- the occasional crash while connecting to the realm has been fixed
- a bug where the oil was not consumed when repairing weapons has been fixed
- fixed a bug where some AIs might not have weapons

notes.title: The new Update is here!

The Update is here! Significant networking improvements! AI upgrades! QOL enhancements! New locations and multiple bug fixes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/dc69db32af0ef4bfe6c97981c175b04c67458d4d.png[/img]

[b]NETWORKING[/b]
- Improved networking: many of the network-related issues should now be resolved

[b]AI[/b]
- AI behavior improvements

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
- Weapon sway compensation has been removed, making hip fire less accurate

[b]QOL AND HUD[/b]

If two containers are open, items will be transferred between them. Now you can quickly add items to the sell list in the traders' section and equip items in the mercenary equipment screen faster

[b]EVENT ITEMS DISCONTINUED[/b]
- Golden Ring, Golden Chalice, and Golden Crown collectible cards are no longer obtainable from the chests, but they still can be exchanged with Mr. Miles Baxter

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the key's durability would decrease by only 20% when opening doors
- Multiple exploits related to Scotts & Co. Iron Mine have been fixed
- A bug where certain items could not be placed in the Pioneer Rucksack has been fixed
- The player spawn point in the Plains has been removed. A camp with outlaws now occupies that spot
- An invisible object in the swamp has been fixed

notes.title: Big Update is here!
notes.notes:
[b]Dear Players![/b]
The Update is here! Significantly reworked AI! Character physics improved! The extraction point lasts longer with a shorter extraction time! The pain starts showing later! Paid mercs now have guns and not only! The loot drops increased! The HUD has more indicators! The max carrying weight is increased! And many many more!

We listened to your feedback and reviews using them as a base for this update. 
Your contribution is priceless. Your time, effort, and dedication make this game better.
Thank you for your involvement and support!

~ ATPTR Team

[h3][b]PATCH NOTES:[/b][/h3]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
- A new craftable pocket-size container "Parts Tin" for gathering weapon parts in raids has been added
- Various looting items have been added to bags and crates found outside settlements (e.g., a bag near a broken wagon by the roadside). And there's a slight chance of finding valuable items there.
- Paid mercenaries. A wider variety of items has been added to their inventory. 
Additionally, paid mercenaries now always come equipped with weapons (similar to those free mercenaries have), and there's a slight chance they may have better weapons with better ammo, better backpacks, sidebags, and some other useful items.
- New quest. Above Renown level 5, Henry Thorne offers a new quest with the "Album" item as a reward after completion. This quest’s reset time is 2 weeks

[b]AI[/b]
- The AI behavior has significantly improved. From now the AI is less tanky and their aiming and vision, and overall battle behavior is based on damage they receive as well as fractures, bleeding, pain, etc.
- From now on, AI characters may have better medical items in their inventory (Express Care Kit, Emergency Health Kit, etc.)
- The chance of finding dollars in AI inventory has been increased
- The AI shots-hearing range has been adjusted

[b]EXTRACTION[/b]
- For the extraction points that previously had a 60-second extraction time, this duration has been changed to 30 seconds. 
- Most ‘paid’ extractions got the option to extract for dollars
- The extraction time is now shown in the extraction information panel
- Now extracting gives 50XP
- The average extraction point lifetime has been increased

[b]PAIN, DEBUFFS & DEATH[/b]
- The pain effects will now appear starting from 80% (instead of 60%)
- Players can't die from thirst with a full stomach, but thirst can still be fatal
- For medicines and drinks that enhance ‘“Pain resistance”, this positive effect has been significantly increased, and the level of “Intoxication” effect has been reduced 
- The pain resistance effect for the "Pain Insensibility", "Migraine", "Osteoporosis", and "Steel-Nerved" perks has been increased
- the negative effects of Diluted Plantain Salves, Bota Bags with River Water, Salmon, Sardines, Oysters, and Seed Potatoes have been reduced

[b]QOL & GAMEPLAY[/b]
- The hunger and the thirst indicators have been added to the HUD
- The stamina visual has been changed
- The animations have been improved
- Character's inertia has been decreased
- Objects can now be dropped while looting from inventory, bodies, and containers.
- A fog has been removed from the Mines location
- Pistols can now be placed in clothing pockets

[b]SOUNDS[/b]
- Consumable items sounds have been adjusted
- Footstep sounds have been adjusted

[b]WEIGHT LOAD[/b]
- the max carrying weight load increased to 33.0kg (it was 30.0kg before)
- the weight debuff curve changed from 0.2-1.0 to 0.35-1.2 (this debuff begins at 35% of max load and peaks at 120%)

[b]FIXES[/b]
- A bug for certain clothes where their armor value would reset to “0” after successful extraction has been fixed
- Tree colliders have been fixed
- An exploit where it was possible to loot items inside houses while standing outside has been fixed
- Several issues with taking fall damage at certain extraction points have been fixed
- An issue with getting stuck in broken wagons has been fixed

notes.title: Important Server announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We need to inform you about some issues we faced during the Early Access release on June 6th. Our game servers experienced DDOS attacks, and when we tried to redirect our players to AWS Fargate, Amazon rejected all the necessary player quota increases. As a result, most players who launched the game in the first few hours ended up on the DDOS-affected servers.

This was the main reason for the issues mentioned in the first players' reviews, such as items and characters disappearing, various shooting problems, NPC and character teleports, and many others.

Now that the performance issue is fixed, we are happy to welcome everyone back to play the game again. Thank you for your feedback, support, and patience! They help us a lot!

The ATPTR Team

notes.title: New Update for A Twisted Path To Renown
notes.notes:
Heya, fellow Buckaroos!
Today it's time to share the upcoming Update details with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/035f0a5e3dbf761abdf4e1ef8e062cf5cb00f8b5.png[/img]

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
- added ‘overall character state’ to the stamina bar
- added new perk "Strength IV"
- new medical items were added: Field Medic Kit, Combat Surgeon's Field Kit, All-Cure Trauma Kit, and Turpentine Kit. Most of these items are versatile, capable of restoring HP, stopping bleeding, and healing fractures
- Clayton Mercer now offers you 3 new quests. Two of them provide metal plates for crafting high-protection clothing, up to level 10 protection. The last one offers a new unique item necessary for crafting unique clothing.

[b]ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
- the quantity and spawn chance of ingredients for clothing crafting have been increased
- due to changes in clothing crafting, the ability to craft thin metal plates and thick metal plates has been removed. However, now they can be obtained by completing a repeatable quest, with up to 10 plates per week. Additionally, the ability to craft Raw Metal Plates, which are necessary for crafting armored clothing up to level 5 protection, has been added.
- clothing crafting has been reworked. Now you also choose your style from a variety of appearance options when crafting clothes
- AI clothing (their armor and weight stats) have been revised due to the new clothing crafting system
- based on your feedback one of Elias Whitmore's quests has been reworked (now the required items will be returned to you as a reward)
- the changes to the .44 revolver crafting have been made to reflect the steel patination processes known at the time more accurately. Now it requires Charcoal. Sulfur Ore will no longer be used.
- The ability to mine Sulfur Ore has been removed, as this process lost its purpose. If you have one left -  you can sell it or keep it as a keepsake artifact.
- Significantly reworked AI

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/465712e02580caa94becf0043077a38815f71b24.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for even more new features and tweaks that make your gameplay of A Twisted Path To Renown even more exciting!

notes.title: Steam Early Access Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/2c706665a4ece84cc17e90809396772e4e9f9b16.png[/img]

⌛ It's almost time until the clock hits High Noon, partners. 

The team is thrilled to announce the official Steam Early Access date reveal trailer for the PvEvP extraction-based first-person shooter [b]A Twisted Path to Renown[/b].

Mark your calendars because starting 📅 [b]June 6th[/b], [b]2024[/b], Steam players will be able to explore the unforgiven Wild West. Looting and shooting are simply the beginning of what is to come.

Expect new craftable level-action rifles, including the new Vanguard '71, new military and bandit groups, revised and realistic ammunition ballistics and muzzle velocity, updated blood splatters, the addition of invulnerability during spawning (no more unfair deaths while loading!) and numerous quality-of-life improvements. New bosses will also appear in random areas throughout the game world, so be vigilant because you never know when you'll run into one.

[previewyoutube=AL0L1hQ5DMY;full][/previewyoutube]

As always, thank you for your support and feedback. We cannot wait to see you on June 6th!  

If you want to be notified when the EA goes live, don't forget to wishlist [b]A Twisted Path to Renown[/b] using the link below, together with keeping up to date with our Steam forums discussions.

notes.title: UPDATE: New gun - Vanguard'71, new ammo and much more
notes.notes:
Here's a brief for the new upcoming Update. It's really [b]big and tasty[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44948826/abbe786fd133e4ec3630ef5b725043118a2dfdc2.jpg[/img]

[b]New Features[/b]

- we added a new weapon - meet Vanguard '71. The lever-action gun that brings even more power to your shooting
- and of course the new .56-50 ammo
- new clothing for some AI has been added
- new spawn points for players have been added

[b]Changes and Adjustments[/b]

- AI has less health now
- ammunition ballistics and spread calculation accuracy and damage at range have been improved
- Model '95 and Model '62 have higher accuracy now, but lower damage also
- shotgun performance has been significantly improved (except slugs)
- some ammunition visual sizes have been adjusted
- the armor class for some old AI clothing has been changed
- the range of goods that may be available for sale from William Thompson and Samuel Cole has been expanded
- initial vault remade from scratch

Cheers!

notes.title: Watch the devs playing - New Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, today we're announcing a new Update for [b]'A Twisted Path To Renown'.[/b]
Here is the short information on the upcoming Update. More information will come soon and all of the next update actuals will be delivered in advance (not as this one today 😉 ).

[b]New Features:[/b]
- now both players and NPCs drop amulets. Amulets serve as an affirmation of your victories as well as valuable resources (you were asking for the dog tags, here they are)
- localization to Ukrainian was added to the game, and early localization was added for German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese (we still need your feedback on improvement)
- added new consumables: Morphine Syringe, Rusty Morphine Syringe, Express Care Kit, Emergency Health Kit, Propolis Treatment Box, Miner Emergency Kit
- new extraction points havce been added, and the requirements for some existing ones have been changed

[b]Changes and Adjustments:[/b]
- the range of goods that may be available for sale from some vendors has been expanded
- animations and visuals for most items have been improved (you will definitely love it)
- the drop list for Medic and his group has been changed
- materials penetration has been significantly reworked
- double-action revolver guns now fire without a delay
- scope visualization has been slightly changed
- changed energy and fullness debuffs, now you'll be moving at a way faster speed even with zero energy and full fullness
- missing texts for a couple of merchants have been added
- since now - digging up a single chest consumes 100% of the shovel's durability
- crafting recipes for certain sidebags and backpacks have been revised. New ingredients required for these crafts have been added: Leather Strap, Reversible Buckle, Carry Strap, Prong Buckle
- reworked ballistics, improved performance of .41V

[b]Fixes:[/b]
- fixed a bug where the shovel could not be listed for sale at the auction
- fixed gun "Phantom shooting" Issue
- fixed Edgar Mills compass barter
